# fynjs

> fyn is a fast node.js package manager. fynpo is a zero setup monorepo manager built on it. fynjs is their monorepo, plus the small packages they are built from.

Each package has one Markdown reference covering its full API, options and runtime
behavior. The same file ships in the npm package at `node_modules/<name>/docs/reference.md`
and matches the installed version.

## Tools

- [fyn](https://fynjs.pages.dev/ref/fyn.md): fyn is a node.js package manager, and supports fynpo -- a zero setup monorepo tool (v3.3.0)
- [fynpo](https://fynjs.pages.dev/ref/fynpo.md): fynpo is a zero setup monorepo manager for node.js (v3.3.0)
- [@fynpo/base](https://fynjs.pages.dev/ref/fynpo-base.md): zero setup monorepo manager for node.js (v2.1.13)
- [fynpo-cli](https://fynjs.pages.dev/ref/fynpo-cli.md): npm install globally to provide the fynpo command (v3.3.0)
- [@fynjs/create-monorepo](https://fynjs.pages.dev/ref/create-monorepo.md): Create a new fynpo monorepo (v1.0.0)
- [@fynjs/run](https://fynjs.pages.dev/ref/xarc-run.md): concurrent or serial run npm scripts, javascript tasks, and more (v1.1.10)

## CLI

- [@fynjs/cli-args](https://fynjs.pages.dev/ref/cli-args.md): Simple, lightweight, flexible, and comprehensive Command Line Argument Parsing for node.js (v1.2.0)
- [chalker](https://fynjs.pages.dev/ref/chalker.md): Set ansi colors in strings using XML and chalk (v2.3.0)
- [visual-logger](https://fynjs.pages.dev/ref/visual-logger.md): Visual logger for CLI in NodeJS (v2.1.10)
- [visual-exec](https://fynjs.pages.dev/ref/visual-exec.md): Visual shell exec with spinners and progress display (v1.2.0)
- [xsh](https://fynjs.pages.dev/ref/xsh.md): Some random NodeJS helper functions for shell execution (v1.1.9)
- [unwrap-npm-cmd](https://fynjs.pages.dev/ref/unwrap-npm-cmd.md): Unwrap npm's node.js bin CMD batch for js files on Windows (v2.1.8)

## Async

- [aveazul](https://fynjs.pages.dev/ref/aveazul.md): Bluebird drop-in replacement built on native Promise (v2.1.9)
- [xaa](https://fynjs.pages.dev/ref/xaa.md): async/await/Promise helpers - delay, defer, timeout, each, map, filter (v3.1.8)
- [item-queue](https://fynjs.pages.dev/ref/item-queue.md): An item processing queue with Promise (v2.2.0)
- [xflight](https://fynjs.pages.dev/ref/xflight.md): Handle inflight promise to avoid async duplication (v3.1.10)

## I/O

- [@fynjs/fetch](https://fynjs.pages.dev/ref/fetch.md): Hardened, zero-dependency HTTP client based on Node core fetch (v1.0.7)
- [filter-scan-dir](https://fynjs.pages.dev/ref/filter-scan-dir.md): Extremely fast recursive directory crawling and filtering for Node.js. (v2.1.11)
- [munchy](https://fynjs.pages.dev/ref/munchy.md): A producer Node stream for draining different data, including Readable streams (v2.0.8)
- [@fynjs/reflink](https://fynjs.pages.dev/ref/reflink.md): Native copy-on-write file cloning for fyn (macOS, Linux, Windows) (v0.2.0)

## Packaging

- [publish-util](https://fynjs.pages.dev/ref/publish-util.md): Some util to clean up package.json for npm publish (v3.1.8)
- [pkg-preper](https://fynjs.pages.dev/ref/pkg-preper.md): Package Preparer (v0.3.8)
- [check-pkg-new-version](https://fynjs.pages.dev/ref/check-pkg-new-version.md): Help npm CLI packages to check newer version (v1.1.9)
- [check-pkg-new-version-engine](https://fynjs.pages.dev/ref/check-pkg-new-version-engine.md): Provide generic engine for npm CLI packages to check newer version (v2.1.8)

## Misc

- [@jchip/error](https://fynjs.pages.dev/ref/error.md): utilities and polyfill for node.js errors (v2.1.8)
- [optional-import](https://fynjs.pages.dev/ref/optional-import.md): ESM import that lets you handle module not found without try/catch, and tells 'not installed' apart from 'installed but broken' (v1.1.8)
- [run-verify](https://fynjs.pages.dev/ref/run-verify.md): Proper test verifications (v2.2.0)
- [string-array](https://fynjs.pages.dev/ref/string-array.md): Parse string into array of string elements (v2.1.8)
- [@fynjs/ts-resolve](https://fynjs.pages.dev/ref/ts-resolve.md): Resolve TypeScript sources for node's built-in type stripping - no transpiler (v1.0.4)
- [xenv-config](https://fynjs.pages.dev/ref/xenv-config.md): Load config from env, user config, or default spec (v2.1.8)
